'''HoloGrids''' were a form of portable data storage technology developed by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the archives of Kashyyyk's [[Claatuvac Guild/Legends|Claatuvac Guild]] were downloaded on to miniature encrypted HoloGrids to prevent their capture by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Guild's main data stacks were then wiped and those Wookiees entrusted with the HoloGrids hid them in locations known only to them.

[[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] was one Wookiee Guild member entrusted with a HoloGrid. As first mate of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], he shared the information on secret [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|routes]] contained within with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], allowing them to make [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] runs in record time. Shortly after the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Chewbacca presented the HoloGrid to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], which used the information on secret routes to great advantage during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
